body:
## Code Review

This pull request implements bilingual (Simplified Chinese and English) UI copy enhancements across various pages of the paper-workspace application, including the Subject Hub, Topic Detail, Error Book, and Search pages. It also updates the i18n dictionaries, corresponding test suites, and the screenshot capture script to support language mode persistence. The review feedback suggests wrapping the local storage initialization in a try-catch block to prevent runtime exceptions in sandboxed environments. Additionally, the reviewer recommends replacing inline optional chaining and fallback objects with dedicated normalization helper functions across several components to defensively handle nullish or undefined props and data structures.
